note: A request beginning with the PROXY v2 signature is routed into the v2 parser with attacker-controlled bytes.
The parser derives the claimed header size from the untrusted length field in the incoming header.
The safety obligation is that the claimed length must not exceed the actual buffered header size before any field access or copy logic proceeds.
If the parser accepts an oversized or malformed v2 header, later field reads/writes use the attacker-shaped header layout and can overrun the intended buffer region.
